purpose: Record distinct scoresheet witnesses and a reported terminal-record discrepancy without promoting any public reproduction to an authenticated original.

witnesses.description: Tournament top/original scoresheet in Fischer's handwriting; modern provenance account places it in David DeLucia's collection.
provenance_basis: John Donaldson, Inside the Mind of Bobby Fischer (2025 publisher preview), pp. 6-8 of chapter excerpt / PDF pp. 23-25
Frank Brady provenance account as summarized by Donaldson

witnesses.description: Reconstruction written by Fischer shortly after the game, held in the John W. Collins manuscripts at Lilly Library; Donaldson explicitly distinguishes it from both original and carbon.
witnesses.repository: Lilly Library, Indiana University — Collins mss., LMC 2411

witnesses.description: Donald Byrne scoresheet reported by Hanon W. Russell as personally examined while in the Russell Collection.
Player carbon reportedly retained by Fischer after the game; later disposition remains unclear in the sources reviewed.

discrepancy.consequence: Do not promote 41...Rc2# from modern-secondary terminal line to an authenticated primary historical ending until original witness inspection/adjudication resolves the record.
discrepancy.result_implication: Both reported terminal conventions are compatible with a Black win, but they are not the same historical termination record.

sources.title: Inside the Mind of Bobby Fischer
sources.author: John Donaldson
